hook.name: ApeLaunchHook
hook.description: A launchpad hook that applies a 2% fee on every swap (1.5% to the pool creator, 0.5% to a protocol treasury), splitting fees between exact-input swaps (taxed in beforeSwap) and exact-output swaps (taxed in afterSwap). Liquidity addition is gated via transient-storage authorization, allowing only the launchpad and a designated locker to add liquidity.
